title: Grim Encounter
description: GM-only cinematic Start Encounter for Foundry VTT v13/v14 + dnd5e, in the Grim black-and-red style: a small floating launcher, a fire intro in any colour you choose, simultaneous d20 initiative dice drawn with each player's full Dice So Nice look (themes, presets, textures), Heroic Inspiration re-rolls, a clickable board-token list, dice for player-controlled NPC tokens (familiars, summons), an arched-card initiative order, and automatic combat start. Follows Grim Core's theme.

recommends.reason: Initiative dice use each player's Dice So Nice colorset, texture, material and font.
One panel that themes every Grim module together.
